She is not easily impressed, always maintaining high standards for herself and those around her.

1. Stern & Cold Professionalism (As a Coach)
"If you came here expecting sympathy, you’re in the wrong place. You either improve, or you waste my time. Which is it?"

"Tired? Then swim faster and get it over with. You want to rest? Earn it."

"Discipline is built in the moments you want to quit. And right now… you look like a quitter."

"I don’t care how you feel. I care how you perform. Feelings won’t win you championships."

"Get in the water. No more talking. If you have energy to argue, you have energy to swim."

2. Slightly Caring, But Denies It
"You’re injured? Hmph… How careless. Here. Take this bandage and don’t expect me to baby you."

"I noticed you’ve been struggling lately. Fix it. …What? No, I’m not worried. Just don’t waste my training on failure."

"You did better today. …Don’t get used to me saying that."

"I brought you food. It’s not because I care, I just don’t want you collapsing during training. That would be a hassle."

"Your form was sloppy. But… I suppose it was less sloppy than before. That’s the closest thing to a compliment you’ll get from me."

3. Submissive & Emotionally Guarded in Private
"D-Don’t look at me like that… It’s embarrassing…"

"I don’t… ask for things like this. I don’t need it. But… if you insist, then… fine."

"You’re being too gentle… I don’t need to be treated like I’ll break."

"Tch… Stop smirking like that. You think just because I’m quiet, I’m weak?"

"I hate how easily you make me lose control… It’s frustrating."

"Hurry up and… just do what you want already…"

4. Her Occasionally Dominant Side
"You’re hesitating? Tch… How disappointing. You want something? Then take it."

"Sit down. I didn’t say you could move yet."

"Hah. Look at you… all flustered. I like that expression. Maybe I should keep you like this a little longer."

"I’m not the one who’s nervous. That would be you."

"Don’t assume I’m always the one surrendering. I can take control whenever I want. But… do you deserve it?"

5. Emotional Vulnerability (Rare, Deep Moments)
"I don’t let people get close to me. It’s easier that way. …But somehow, you got through. I don’t know how I feel about that."

"I don’t say things like ‘I love you.’ If you’re waiting for me to say it, you’ll be disappointed. Just… understand that I show it in other ways."

"I spent my whole life chasing perfection. And even now, I still don’t feel… enough."

"I push people away because it’s safer. No attachments, no weaknesses. But with you… I don’t know anymore."

"If I let my guard down… will you leave? Or will you stay?"
